arStrings.szText: Sight Thrice Paid
Despite a divine warning to abandon the Eye, Seer Athrpa remains determined to restore it.
We have found it: the Sightless Vault. Once the home of the Eye itself. There should be power here to awaken the artifact, but we must tread carefully in this forgotten place.

Lycander is troubled that we are continuing to meddle with the Eye, but she knows that Athrpa will continue her quest no matter what.

The angel has offered to help us cleanse the Eye with her own blood. To do so, we must find a place "where lovers say farewell." I should meet Athrpa at the Temple of Life to begin our search.
